field_defs.hint: Panel model and rating, from its label. Tilts to 90/70/60/45/30 degrees.

field_defs.hint: Lamp or sun, and its setting (dimmer level, or distance and time of day).

field_defs.hint: Resistor value and power rating on the converter output.

field_defs.hint: On-chip ADC range used for this session.

steps.title: ADC range and check
steps.instructions: Switch the ADC range to Mid: two panels in series reach roughly 34-44 V, past the Low range. Check the ADC reading against a meter (see docs/hardware_v1/calibration.md, "Changing the ADC range"). Pass: the range is Mid and the check agrees with the meter within about 1%.

steps.title: Firmware configuration
steps.instructions: Check the firmware is built as MppTracker, with ADC_DIVIDER_RANGE = Mid and MAX31865_ENABLED = false. Check the boot log shows the range and T=n/a. Pass: both match.

steps.title: Bypass diode check
steps.instructions: Check each panel's bypass diode is present and correctly oriented. With two panels in series, a shaded panel without a working bypass diode can be driven into reverse breakdown. Pass: both diodes check out.

steps.title: Load on the output
steps.instructions: Connect two 10 Ohm, 10 W resistors in series (20 Ohm total) to the converter output on J4. Pass: the load is connected and rated for the expected power.

steps.title: Heatsink and power cut
steps.instructions: Check that Q3 has its heatsink fitted, or plan to keep runs short. Check that someone at the bench can cut power right away. Pass: both are true.

steps.title: Workbench mode and connection
steps.instructions: Check the workbench is in Full mode. Check the PICO connected pill is shown. Pass: both are true.

steps.title: Run config limits
steps.instructions: Open the run config and check it shows v_max 40 V, i_max 1 A, v_out_max 25 V. Pass: all three match.

steps.title: Link status before a sweep
steps.instructions: With nothing running, open the connection menu (top right of the workbench) and read the raw link line. Pass: it reads "waiting for sweep".

steps.title: Light check
steps.instructions: With both panels at 90 degrees, run one sweep. Record Isc, in amps. Pass: Isc matches what is expected for the light level. If it does not, adjust the light and sweep again.

steps.title: Baseline curve
steps.instructions: Save 3 sweeps with both panels at 90 degrees, one after the other, as the baseline curves. The session shows the median and spread of Voc, Isc and P at the MPP. Pass: the 3 curves are saved and linked here.

steps.title: Curve at B = 70 degrees
steps.instructions: Tilt panel B to 70 degrees, panel A stays at 90. Save 3 sweeps, one after the other. Pass: the 3 curves are saved and linked here.

steps.title: Curve at B = 60 degrees
steps.instructions: Tilt panel B to 60 degrees, panel A stays at 90. Save 3 sweeps, one after the other. Pass: the 3 curves are saved and linked here.

steps.title: Curve at B = 45 degrees
steps.instructions: Tilt panel B to 45 degrees, panel A stays at 90. Save 3 sweeps, one after the other. Pass: the 3 curves are saved and linked here.

steps.title: Curve at B = 30 degrees
steps.instructions: Tilt panel B to 30 degrees, panel A stays at 90. Save 3 sweeps, one after the other. Pass: the 3 curves are saved and linked here, and they show two local maxima (partial shading).

steps.title: P&O run
steps.instructions: Start a Perturb & Observe run with the B = 30 degree curve as reference, 10 s duration, starting duty 0.5. Pass: recorded and linked here, noting which peak it settles on. Do it 3 times and link every run: the session shows the median and spread of the results.

steps.title: Scan & Track run
steps.instructions: Start a Scan & Track run with the same settings (B = 30 degree curve, 10 s, starting duty 0.5). Pass: recorded and linked here, noting which peak it settles on. Do it 3 times and link every run: the session shows the median and spread of the results.

steps.title: Particle Swarm run
steps.instructions: Start a Particle Swarm run with the same settings (B = 30 degree curve, 10 s, starting duty 0.5). Pass: recorded and linked here, noting which peak it settles on. Do it 3 times and link every run: the session shows the median and spread of the results.

steps.title: Seed test near the lower peak
steps.instructions: Start a P&O run seeded at a starting duty near the lower peak of the B = 30 degree curve. Pass: recorded and linked here, noting which peak it settles on. Do it 3 times and link every run: the session shows the median and spread of the results.

steps.title: Downloads
steps.instructions: Check that every curve and run used in this session is downloaded, and that this session is downloaded as Markdown. Pass: all files are saved.

open_questions.text: Panel temperature is not measured (no PT100 fitted; the MAX31865 is off). Voc falls with temperature, so curves taken at different times are not strictly comparable. How to record it: a contact thermometer on the panel back, an IR thermometer, or a fitted PT100?
Was there any unexpected behaviour during the session?
